fields.title: Selected workload and ConfigMap literals have no detected secrets
fields.description: Inspect literal environment values, command and args in exact selected Kubernetes workload PodSpecs and text data in ConfigMaps using both offline detectors. Controllers are assessed through their current templates; running replicas and referenced content are outside coverage.
evaluated: Exact selected GVK, cluster, namespace, name, UID and resourceVersion across two authenticated named GETs
PodSpec containers/initContainers/ephemeralContainers literal env.value, command and args
Pod spec; apps and Job spec.template.spec; CronJob spec.jobTemplate.spec.template.spec; PodTemplate template.spec
ConfigMap data string values and bounded text binaryData
Both pinned offline engines, HMAC value deduplication and union redaction
fields.pass_when: Both offline detectors complete on the supported identity-bound selected literals without detecting a supported secret indicator.
fields.fail_when: A completed offline detector finds a supported secret indicator in fully bound selected literals. Failure remains decisive with incomplete coverage when the other detector is unavailable.
fields.not_applicable_when: Disabled, missing, unsupported or incomplete selected content never establishes a clean result.
fields.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected workload specifications or ConfigMaps and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use supported secret references or workload identities.
fields.purpose: Named selected current declarations only, including controller templates. No Secret payloads, reference resolution, execution, effective runtime state, credential verification or entire-cluster coverage.

changes.root_hook: peaso.checks.k8s_literal_current_metadata_20261020.install after original literal.install; root native-extension metadata row update, preserve predecessor admission.

changes.description: Resolve each regular, init and ephemeral container declaration over the Pod seccomp default. Each assessed declaration must resolve to RuntimeDefault; this does not verify kernel enforcement.
changes.observation: An assessed regular, init or ephemeral container declares or inherits the observed non-RuntimeDefault profile, or has no known declaration.

changes.description: Check regular containers for nonzero hostPort declarations. Zero is the native no-publication default; this does not establish actual reachability.
changes.observation: Regular container “<observed name>” declares hostPort <observed nonzero integer>.

changes.description: Resolve declared RuntimeDefault seccomp for observed Linux regular and init containers, including container overrides. Unresolved OS/profile stays UNKNOWN; ephemeral containers and kernel enforcement are outside this criterion.
changes.observation: Assessed Linux container “<observed name>” declares or inherits <observed profile> seccomp instead of RuntimeDefault.
